name: Abundant Life
overview: Scripture reveals that abundant life is found through a wholehearted trust in the LORD rather than relying on human understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. This life is marked by divine guidance and satisfaction even in difficult times, likened to a well-watered garden that does not fail (Isaiah 58:11). Believers receive the privilege to become children of God by faith in Christ (John 1:12), and by seeking first God's kingdom and righteousness, all necessary blessings are assured (Matthew 6:33). Furthermore, God’s plans for His people are for peace and a hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11), while the path to this blessed life involves avoiding ungodly counsel and sinful ways (Psalms 1:1).
